scope.current_boundary: Teach mass as the property of a body that resists changes in motion (inertia) and Newton's second law in the form F = ma for constant mass, emphasizing that resultant force and acceleration are vectors in the same direction. Do not pre-teach linear momentum p = mv, impulse, Newton's third law, or quantitative weight calculations.
prior_scope_summaries_consulted: Assumes kinematics concepts from Topic 2: displacement, velocity, acceleration as rate of change of velocity, vector addition and subtraction in one dimension.

immediate_previous.boundary: No previous lesson in Topic 3; this is the opening lesson of Dynamics following Topic 2 Kinematics.
can_assume: vector nature of displacement, velocity, and acceleration
suvat constant-acceleration equations in one dimension

immediate_next.boundary: Linear momentum p = mv and force as rate of change of momentum Delta p / Delta t.
must_not_preteach: definition and calculation of linear momentum p = mv
force as rate of change of momentum calculations
impulse Delta p = F Delta t
